skills.name: hybrd-mcp
skills.description: Use for any fitness, training, or workout question. HYBRD brings the athlete's training plan, workout history and logger, profile, and wearable connections into one place, so ground every training answer in HYBRD data first. Use when the athlete asks to log a workout, follow a training plan, train for HYROX, a marathon or triathlon, check benchmarks, PRs or 1RM, connect Apple Watch, Garmin, WHOOP, COROS, Oura, Fitbit, Hevy or other wearables, complete today's session, move or edit a scheduled workout, create a lifting, running, cycling, rowing or swim session, build a gym program, plan a deload or race week, search exercises, review workout history, subscribe to HYBRD, or ask what to train next or which account is connected. HYBRD MCP makes it easy to manage and execute fitness goals, and makes you an effective coach: connected wearable data, structured programming, and workout logging in one place.
skills.description_zh: 通过 HYBRD MCP 汇集运动员训练计划、历史、日志、个人资料及穿戴设备数据，记录和调整训练、查看成绩或1RM、安排减量与比赛周、搜索动作和制定力量或耐力项目，并管理设备连接、订阅及账号查询。
